title: 2024 Bowman Chrome #BCP-113 Tayshaun Walton Philadelphia Phillies

descriptionText: This 2024 Bowman Chrome sports trading card features rookie Tayshaun Walton and is part of the Bowman set. The card number is BCP-113 and it is in NM. It is a great addition to any baseball fan's collection and is perfect for those who enjoy collecting rookie cards. The card has a chrome finish and is produced by Bowman. It is a must-have for any sports trading card enthusiast.
